Property taxes catch many buyers off guard in Ridgefield CT. When you look at homes this November, remember that Connecticut calculates assessments at seventy percent of market value, not purchase price. Each town sets a specific mill rate that determines your annual bill. Understanding this math prevents surprises in your monthly mortgage payment.
